reference_transcript: For about two weeks, I have been having burning pain in the upper part of my stomach, particularly after eating spicy food or drinking coffee. Sometimes I feel acid coming up into my throat when I lie down at night. Have you vomited blood, noticed black stools, lost weight unexpectedly, or had difficulty swallowing? No. I have not noticed blood in my vomit or stool, I have not lost weight, and I am eating normally. Have you tried any medication for these symptoms? I tried omeprazole twenty milligrams once daily for three days. It helped a little. I would like you to take omeprazole twenty milligrams once every morning before breakfast for fourteen days. Avoid eating immediately before going to bed, and try to reduce spicy food and coffee during this period. When should I return? Arrange a follow-up in two weeks so we can review whether the treatment helped. Come back earlier if you develop severe abdominal pain, difficulty swallowing, vomiting blood, black stools, or unexplained weight loss.
